name.en: Existing source data item

name.zh-cn: 目标父节点与资源名称
name.en: Target parent node and resource name

name.zh-cn: 执行边界
name.en: Runtime boundary

name.zh-cn: 装载模式
name.en: Load mode

name.zh-cn: 目标写入策略
name.en: Target apply policy

name.zh-cn: 实际输出到目标字段的映射
name.en: Actual output to target field mapping

name.zh-cn: 一次实际运行
name.en: An actual execution

name.zh-cn: 源身份唯一，并有正式 owner 返回的结构事实
name.en: Unique source identity with formal owner schema facts

name.zh-cn: 真实目标父节点和明确的目标名称
name.en: Observed target parent and explicit target name

name.zh-cn: 有界的一次性执行边界
name.en: Bounded one-time runtime boundary

name.zh-cn: 快照装载模式
name.en: Snapshot load mode

name.zh-cn: 快照写入明确选择 replace（清理后写入）或 append（仅追加），不支持 upsert
name.en: Explicit snapshot policy: replace (clear then write) or append (insert only); upsert is not supported

name.zh-cn: 按真实结构分别确认行粒度与字段保留范围；不展开数组不等于删除数组字段，删减须明确确认；查询与映射随完整配置复核
name.en: Confirm row grain and retained fields separately from schema facts; not expanding arrays does not mean dropping them, and omissions need explicit confirmation; review query and mapping with the full configuration

name.zh-cn: 用户确认确切配置；参数、能力修订或结构事实变化后重新确认
name.en: User reviews exact configuration; changed arguments, capability revision or schema facts require a new review

name.zh-cn: 完整配置经正式只读预检；unsupported 阻止创建，unknown 明示限制后知情确认；创建前复检，稳定事实变化后重新确认
name.en: Formal read-only check of complete arguments; unsupported blocks creation, unknown requires informed confirmation; recheck before creation and re-review changed stable facts

name.zh-cn: Transfer 完整配置的正式只读预检入口；草稿明确要求检查时也使用，不进入创建复核或批准创建；不读取业务行或保证执行成功
name.en: Formal read-only check entry for complete Transfer arguments, also used when a draft check is explicitly requested without creation review or approval; no business rows or execution guarantee

name.zh-cn: 源身份与结构取证入口：搜索定位后读取正式结构事实，不以候选代替事实
name.en: Source evidence entry: discover identity, then read formal schema facts; candidates are not facts

name.zh-cn: 目标父节点取证入口：读取真实目录与祖先，不读取尚未创建的目标
name.en: Target parent evidence entry: read actual children and ancestors, not a nonexistent target

name.zh-cn: 用户对 Runtime 绑定的确切参数与当前事实进行确认，不能由读取 Tool 代替
name.en: User confirmation of Runtime-bound exact arguments and current facts; no read Tool can replace it
